findings.claim: An explicit cursor can still silently resume from the retained floor if retention advances after the one-time preflight check.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 4/global rule requires expiry/resnapshot to fail closed with `resnapshot_required`; `reject_expired_cursor` only snapshots and checks `from < floor` before subscription, while the spawned poll loop decodes and forwards messages without validating that the first delivered broker offset is not greater than the requested explicit offset.
findings.suggested_fix: For non-BEGINNING subscriptions, validate the first polled message: if its broker offset is greater than the requested `from`, emit `PortError::NotFound("resnapshot_required: ...")` instead of forwarding it; keep the preflight check as an optimization.

findings.claim: The proposal document is stale because it says the change is proposal-only with unchecked implementation tasks while the same diff marks all tasks complete and ships implementation files.
findings.evidence: `proposal.md` adds `Status: proposal only; all implementation tasks are unchecked.`, but `openspec/changes/pri-c007-broker-replay/tasks.md` marks tasks 1 through 5 as `[x]` and the diff adds product code under `crates/frf-broker-iggy/`; constraint T2 requires docs match code.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the proposal status to reflect that implementation and local acceptance are complete, or remove the stale unchecked-task statement.
